subject.title: [Bug]: Non-Anthropic models output tool calls as plain text '[tool: exec]' instead of tool_use blocks

question: What should OpenClaw do when a tool-capable provider emits only a bare `[tool:name]` marker with no arguments in an assistant turn?
rationale: The source shows the marker cannot be safely promoted into a real tool call today, and every plausible fix changes provider/runtime compatibility or fallback behavior.

options.title: Define bounded recovery
options.body: Recommended: choose a contract such as warning plus retry/fallthrough/blocking without executing argument-less markers, then add live provider proof and tests.

options.title: Document unsupported models
options.body: Treat this as provider/model incompatibility, keep current runtime behavior, and point users to lean mode or `compat.supportsTools: false`.

options.title: Promote bare markers
options.body: Attempting to execute bare markers would need a new argument-synthesis policy and should not happen without explicit security and product approval.

recommendation.title: Define bounded recovery
recommendation.body: Recommended: choose a contract such as warning plus retry/fallthrough/blocking without executing argument-less markers, then add live provider proof and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a default agent-runtime security and compatibility policy choice, and this owner has the strongest adjacent history in fake tool-call diagnostics and SDK-boundary shaping.
